title: Annual WRJA Judo Tournament
content: The WRJA Annual Judo Tournament takes place on the first Saturday of December each year at the Randburg Sports Complex. Categories include children, adults, and women. Registration opens two months before the event. All members are encouraged to participate. Spectators welcome! This is our biggest event of the year.

title: Judo for Beginners Workshop
content: Our Judo for Beginners Workshop is held on the last Saturday of every month from 10:00-12:00 at our Randburg dojo. This is a free event for anyone interested in learning the basics of judo. All ages welcome. No experience required. Registration is not required - just show up!

title: Women's Self-Defense Workshop
content: WRJA hosts a monthly Women's Self-Defense Workshop on the third Saturday of every month from 14:00-16:00. This workshop teaches practical self-defense techniques based on judo principles. Cost is R100 per session. All women ages 15 and above are welcome.

title: Belt Grading Exams
content: Belt Grading Exams are held every quarter (March, June, September, December) at our Randburg dojo. Students who are ready for their next belt can sign up with their instructor. The grading fee is R200. Exam dates are announced on our website and notice board.
